comment: The format definition of Reg M-C (restructure step 10, docs/architecture/formats.md). Hand-written. Every value names the line of the pinned Showdown checkout it comes from; tools/datagen/gen_format.py --pin <checkout> compares each quote with its line and reads the value back from it. tools/datagen/gen_format.py writes src/data/format_tables.h from this file; gen_closure.py reads the format id and the pool source from it.

engine.comment: The facts the C engine uses, as named constants of src/data/format_tables.h (DFI_FORMAT_<NAME>). active_per_side is the position count of game_type doubles.

pool.made_by: docs/research/expansion/tools/build_legal_pool.js: the pinned TeamValidator for showdown_format_id at showdown_commit (its meta names both)

tables.comment: What tools/datagen/gen_closure.py --pool --format reg-mc builds (restructure step 5): the Champions rule set (its override files, their pinned hashes and the PP cap of 20 live in tools/datagen/tablegen/source.py), the symbols dfi_pool_* and DFI_POOL_* of src/data/pool_tables.{h,c}, 64 learnset bytes (one bit per pool move: 511 moves), and the id bounds of the engine fields today (formes below 0xFFFF and moves up to 0xFFFF as u16 ids; items and abilities 254, u8 with 0xFF as none; 512 legal moves per forme, DUOFORGE_DATA_MAX_FORME_MOVES). Every value is required; nothing is excluded from the pool.
